title: Seat lesson 2: the operator
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/osa_ak.json: equipment_on, deploy_at_halt, capture_with_ssc) with their sources
notes: The lesson's scenario starts with the headset off. The commander's orders are given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace. Explanations follow the procedures' and subsystems' own notes and sources.

steps.title: The operator's seat
lines: You are the operator (оператор дальности): seat 1 of the Osa 21, in the middle of the compartment, facing the left wall.
You bring the equipment to life at К бою, you unlock the turret and switch on its drives, and in the fight you run the tracking radar's range: its transmitter, its range gate, and the capture.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: Your headset (шлемофон)
lines: First your шлемофон: put it on and plug its cord into your Р-124 box.
Without it you hear only the cabin: the commander's orders come on the intercom.
steps.why: The Osa's crew work in their headsets: the turbine and the fans drown a voice in the cabin (r124_refs; voenizdat_osa_1991).
steps.hint: J: put it on (or point the cross at it, left click).

steps.title: The distribution cabinet 0096-9M1
lines: Behind you, at the back of the compartment: the distribution cabinet. Its switches feed the turbine's power to everything else: the equipment, the search antenna's stabilisation, the TV sight, the drives, and the turret's travel lock.
Its lamps tell you what is running.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: Your panel: the tracking radar's range
lines: In front of you: the range panel of the tracking radar (СОЦ searches, ССЦ tracks). ПЕРЕДАТЧИК, the transmitter, sits under a red guard; beside it СДЦ, the moving-target filter, and the РАБОТА — КОНТРОЛЬ switch; below, the range wheel.

steps.title: The range indicator
lines: The range indicator shows what the tracking radar hears along its beam: two sweeps, the lower one magnified round the range gate. A target's echo stands up from the sweep as a spike; the gate is the bright mark you move with the range wheel.
The counter above it reads the gate's range in metres.

steps.title: The commander: «К бою!»
lines: «К бою!» (Action stations!) brings the whole crew to readiness. Your part: switch the equipment on, then unlock the turret and switch on its drives.
Listen: the crew acknowledges on the intercom, «Есть!». The driver starts the gas-turbine unit: you need its power first.

steps.title: Report your seat: «Третий готов!»
lines: At your place, your headset on: report to the commander on the intercom: O, then «Третий готов!» (Seat three ready!).
steps.why: The intercom check: each seat says it is in place and hears the commander (voenizdat_osa_1991 p. 246). The R-124 runs on the vehicle's 27 V: it works before the turbine is up.
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Switch the equipment on
lines: On the distribution cabinet: flip АППАРАТУРА up to ВКЛ.
steps.why: It feeds the turbine's 220 V 400 Hz to all the racks: the radars, the computer, the drives. Their sweeps show after a minute; the transmitters are ready (ГОТОВ) after three.
steps.wait_text: the driver's turbine to give power (about a minute; the lesson runs time faster)

steps.title: Stabilisation on
lines: Flip СИСТЕМА СТАБ. up to ВКЛ.
steps.why: The search antenna's stabilisation keeps its beam level while the hull rocks. Once it runs, the antenna rises from its travel position.

steps.title: Free the search antenna
lines: Flip РАССТОПОР. — СТОПОР. to РАССТОПОР.
steps.why: It frees the search antenna to turn: the senior operator will set it rotating for the search.

steps.title: Power the TV sight
lines: Flip ТОВ — ОТКЛ. to ТОВ.
steps.why: It powers the TV sight on the turret: the deputy commander's camera, which sees the target when the radars can't or mustn't.

steps.title: Unlock the turret: «Расстопорить АПУ!»
lines: Flip the АПУ travel lock to unlocked (the vehicle must be standing still: it is).
steps.why: The antenna-launcher unit (АПУ): the turret with the tracking radar and the six missiles. It is locked for the march; unlocked, it can turn. Never drive off with it unlocked: it faults.

steps.title: Azimuth drive on
lines: Flip ПРИВОД βн up to ВКЛ.
steps.why: The motor that turns the turret in azimuth (βн): without it the tracking radar can't be pointed.

steps.title: Elevation drives on
lines: Flip ПРИВОДЫ εн, СВР-I, СВР-II up to ВКЛ.
steps.why: The tracking radar's elevation drive (εн) and the two missile trackers' (СВР-I and II), which follow the missiles in flight.

steps.title: Report it: «АПУ расстопорено!»
lines: Tell the crew: open your reports with O and pick «АПУ расстопорено!» (Launcher-antenna unit unlocked!). The deputy commander waits for it.
steps.why: Knowledge moves only by voice: in the real crew nobody can see your switches, so you say what you did.
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Warming up
lines: The transmitters need three minutes before high voltage. Your ГОТОВ lamp lights when they are ready.
Meanwhile the search antenna rises and the deputy commander orients the vehicle. The lesson runs time faster.
steps.wait_text: the transmitters to warm up (ГОТОВ, three minutes)

steps.title: A target
lines: A practice drone is flying at you from the north-west. The senior operator searches for it with the search radar and calls its azimuth and range on the intercom.
When the commander orders it taken, you capture it with the tracking radar.

steps.title: Search
lines: Listen for the senior operator's report: «Цель, азимут …, дальность …!»
steps.wait_text: the senior operator to find the target and report it

steps.title: The commander: «Цель — взять!»
lines: «Цель номер … — взять!» (Take the target!). The senior operator turns the tracking radar onto it in azimuth and the deputy commander presses ЦУ: the radar searches up and down that line for it. Your part: the range, and the transmitter.

steps.title: Range indicator to РАБОТА
lines: Turn РАБОТА / КОНТРОЛЬ / КАЛИБР. back to РАБОТА (it stands at КОНТРОЛЬ).
steps.why: РАБОТА shows the radar's real picture; КОНТРОЛЬ and КАЛИБР. are test modes.
steps.hint: Right click steps a selector back, left click steps it on.

steps.title: СДЦ on
lines: Flip СДЦ / ШТ. to СДЦ.
steps.why: СДЦ, the moving-target filter, drops the echoes of the ground that don't move, so the radar can hold a low target in the clutter.

steps.title: Lift the guard over ПЕРЕДАТЧИК
lines: Lift the red guard over ПЕРЕДАТЧИК.
steps.why: Guards keep the switches that radiate or fire from being flipped by accident: the switch under one can't move until it is up.

steps.title: Transmitter on: ПЕРЕДАТЧИК ВКЛ.
lines: Flip ПЕРЕДАТЧИК up to ВКЛ. once the deputy commander has pressed ЦУ.
steps.why: The tracking radar radiates: the range indicator shows the echoes along its beam, and the capture circuit (АЗ) can take the target.
steps.wait_text: the deputy commander's ЦУ (it points the tracking radar at the target)

steps.title: Put the range gate on the echo
lines: Turn the range wheel until the gate sits on the target's echo: the range counter at the range the senior operator called, then on the spike on your indicator. Keep it on: the radar captures by itself when the gate holds the echo, and ТСЦ and АВТОМАТ light.
steps.why: The capture circuit needs the gate within about 750 m of the echo, and the drone keeps closing: follow it.
steps.hint: Hold the left button on the wheel and drag sideways, or roll the mouse wheel over it. The card shows the gate and the mark.
steps.wait_text: a range for the target (the senior operator's report, or its echo on your indicator)

steps.title: Report it: «Захват!»
lines: Tell the crew: O, then «Захват!» (Captured!). The commander waits for it before he orders the missiles prepared.
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The commander: «Приготовиться к пуску!»
lines: The deputy commander prepares the missiles and puts the key in. Your job now is to keep the capture: the radar tracks by itself (АВТОМАТ), and you watch the echo stays in the gate.

steps.title: Into the zone
lines: Wait for ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ: the drone inside the missiles' reach. The deputy commander calls «Цель в зоне!».
steps.wait_text: the target to come into the firing zone

steps.title: The commander: «Пуск разрешаю!»
lines: Launch permitted: the deputy commander turns the key and presses ПУСК. Press F6 to follow the missile, F1 to come back.

steps.title: Missile away
lines: The missile flies on the tracking radar's commands: your capture is what guides it. Keep watching your range indicator, or follow the missile with F6.
steps.wait_text: the missile to reach the drone

steps.title: The operator's part: done
lines: That is the operator's part of the drill: the equipment on at К бою, the turret unlocked and its drives on, and in the fight the transmitter, the range gate and the capture.
Practise it without the highlights: the Missions group's «Osa: crew practice, one target», starting in the operator's seat, with H set to hint. Or the next lesson: the senior operator.
Esc: the menu.
